steps: Check replica lag, confirm primary health, fail over only with DBA sign-off. Never truncate. Escalate to platform if lag exceeds 300s.
Confirm blast radius from two vantage points before declaring. Check recent config pushes first. Do not restart the load balancer during business hours.
Never disable MFA to clear an incident. Rotate the affected credential, invalidate sessions, then confirm the error rate falls before closing.
Expand before you delete. Confirm retention policy with the data owner. Snapshot before any destructive operation.
Roll back before you debug forward. Capture the failing manifest first. A stuck canary past 30 minutes is an automatic rollback.
